notes.title: Happy birthday to Nora!
notes.content: [p]Yesterday was a special day indeed, as it was our favorite rebel’s birthday!  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781365/daf0b4d0e420a03cf5e6d6d987e05e5230243d24.jpg"][/img][i](Text version below)[/i] [/p][p]But! We wanted to do a little more, kind of treat today as a Nora Appreciation Day, so we’ve compiled some of our favorite fanart of her to show to you. Go show the artists some love! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781365/576f22970451e2b5e9f480b188380d68d6a99019.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b][url="https://x.com/Daumnicix/status/1903236091144024172"]@Daumnicix[/url][/b] on X (Maree)[/p][/*][*][p][b][url="https://x.com/Sleepwalkalot/status/1934150762545995889"]@Sleepwalkalot[/url][/b] on X[/p][/*][*][p][b]@lorena_maneira[/b] on [b][url="https://x.com/lorena_maneira"]X[/url][/b] & [b][url="https://www.instagram.com/p/C0sLukHp85L/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA=="]Insta[/url][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][url="https://x.com/doodlenoodleh/status/1917613527696552103"]@doodlenoodleh[/url][/b] on X[/p][/*][*][p][b][url="https://x.com/noxdrawing/status/1925752138698735878/photo/2"]@noxdrawing[/url][/b] on X[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Nora’s letter: [/p][p][/p][p]I used to love birthdays.[/p][p]The attention, the candles, the feeling that, just for a moment, I mattered more than anything else.[/p][p]But now, they just remind me of the people I’ve lost.[/p][p]The versions of myself I left behind.[/p][p]When I was younger, I used to dream big on this day. I'd light candles and make the same wish every year: "Let things stay the same."[/p][p]They never did.[/p][p]I’ve spent a lot of time running from that summer, from the truth, from the parts of me that scare even myself. But this year feels… different. [/p][p]Maybe because I’m finally ready to face it. All of it.[/p][p][b]The bloom. The rage.[/b][/p][p]The fire in the clearing.[/p][p]Some memories never left me, no matter how hard I tried to forget.[/p][p]I thought it would hurt less that way. [/p][p]I’m not sure it does.[/p][p][/p][p]Nora[/p]

notes.title: Announcing Aphelion, DON'T NOD’s new sci-fi adventure!
notes.content: [p]We’re thrilled to present [i]Aphelion[/i], DON’T NOD’s newly announced sci-fi action-adventure game!  [/p][p]Set in a near-future where Earth faces collapse, [i]Aphelion[/i] is an emotional journey to the edge of our Solar System to survey a planet that may be humanity’s last hope. Our latest tale follows two European Space Agency astronauts: Ariane Montclair and Thomas Cross. Following their crash landing on the uncharted planet Persephone, they must brave harsh landscapes, master survival tools, gather crucial information, and navigate reality-bending phenomena in a desperate mission to reunite. [/p][p][/p][p]Check out the reveal trailer:  [/p][previewyoutube="GqvbEVNTcPo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]Aphelion[/i] blends our signature emotional storytelling with immersive exploration and traversal, mystery, and tense stealth gameplay. What begins as a totally compromised mission becomes an adventure into the unknown. As you explore the frozen world of Persephone, you’ll gather information on the planet’s strange conditions and what could’ve caused the crash of Ariane and Thomas’s ship, the Hope 01. [/p][p][b]A game in collaboration with the European Space Agency[/b] [/p][p]We’re also super honored to announce that the game is developed in collaboration with the European Space Agency (ESA)! Ariane and Thomas are both ESA astronauts, part of the fictional Hope 01 mission to survey a new potential home for humanity. We’re grounding our depiction of space exploration in real scientific knowledge and humanistic values. This very cool collaboration weaves authentic elements of space science into the emotional core of the game.  [/p][p]After all, this isn’t just a game about a planet. It’s a very human tale of how we behave when all hope is lost, and what keeps us going. [/p][p][i]Aphelion[/i] will launch in 2026 but you can wishlist it right now! [/p][p]To keep up with news on the game, follow us on [url="https://twitter.com/DONTNOD_Ent"][u]X[/u][/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/dontnod_ent/"][u]Instagram[/u][/url] and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@dont_nod"][u]TikTok[/u][/url]! [/p]

notes.title: Tape 2 Patch 3 (build 2.03.131125)

[list]

[*]In Chapter ‘Garage Band’ (Tape 1), fixed an invisible toy interaction.
[*]In Chapter ‘Bloom…’ (Tape 1), fixed teleporting drinks animations.
[*]In Chapter ‘Alone Again’ (Tape 2), fixed an issue with the ‘Read’ overlay UI displaying text when examining Nora's and Autumn’s poems up close.
[*]In Chapter ‘A Tale of Two Sisters’ (Tape 2), fixed a continuity issue where picking up Pam’s book without returning it to her would incorrectly trigger the same outcome in later scenes.
[*]In Chapter ‘Pieces of Autumn’ (Tape 2), fixed animation issue on Autumn when she’s supposed to pick up her bag and walk out of the cabin.
[*]In Chapter ‘Infiltration’ (Tape 2), fixed flow issues during the moment where player signal Kat’s to prevent animation issues or potential VO overlapping.
[*]In Chapter ‘Infiltration’ (Tape 2), improved the balance of pathways to walk past Corey around the firepit, ensuring that hitting the bird feeder consistently triggers a fail state.
[*]In Chapter ‘Infiltration’ (Tape 2), added an animation where the player attempts to grab Nora’s hand in the present timeline as she prepares to leave.
[*]In Chapter ‘Hunted’ (Tape 2), fixed missing music.
[*]In Chapter ‘Time Capsule’ (Tape 2), improved stagging around the reveal of the mystery packages and fixed related camera issues.

[*]Fixed issue where shadows could be presented at a very low resolution when using the camcorder.
[*]Fixed issue where some videos would not be cleaned up from future scenes when restarting through scene selection in Story Mode.

[*]Last played scene is now properly highlighted after replaying a scene from Tape 2 in collectible mode.
[*]Fixed issue where the 'Punk Showdown' memoir could be impossible to complete.
[*]Multiple safeguards have been added to avoid crashes during gameplay.
[*]Fixed radio advertisements not playing throughout the game.
[*]Fixed multiple typos in ‘Read’ overlay UI that display texts when examining closer objects.
[*]Fixed various subtitle timings or mismatches with the actual VO.
[*]Fixed various issues when examining closer objects so that they don’t render blurry.

notes.title: Tape 2 Patch 2 (build 2.02.130347)
notes.content:
Hi,

This second patch comes with numerous bug fixes and significant polish on all fronts!

Only the key highlights are listed in these release notes.

Please do not hesitate to report any bug you encounter in-game to our [url=https://support.dont-nod.com/hc/en-gb/requests/new]support platform[/url].

See you in Velvet Cove!

[h3]New features[/h3]

[list]
[*]In Settings menu, added a new option to change the subtitle color (white, pink, green, red, blue).
[*]In Settings menu, added a subtitle preview to visualize customization (background, size, color).
[*]Implemented contextual colors on the controller light bar for Dual Sense users.
[*]In camcorder view, added an option to reset the motion control camera tilt by clicking the left thumbstick (on platforms and controllers supporting motion control).[/list]

[h3]Game Progression Blockers Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue in Chapter ‘… & Rage’ (Tape 1), where exiting the lock pad while Kat was still talking then re-entering it would prevent progression.
[*]Fixed an issue in Chapter ‘Alone Again’ (Tape 2),  where inputting a full phone number before the dialogue finishes would block progression.
[*]Fixed an issue in Chapter ‘Infiltration’ (Tape 2), where player could get out of bounds and block progression.[/list]

[h3]Crash Fixes[/h3]

[list]
While investigating random crashes that multiple players experienced with our game, we ended up disabling the FSR upscaling feature (and related rendering code) on machines running with non-AMD graphics cards (most notably Nvidia). Discussions on Unreal and Nvidia developer communities led us to think this could be the source of crashes which have been reported to us. This could help reduce crashes even if you did not have the FSR feature enabled in the game’s graphics options menu.
Moreover, Nvidia just released a major driver update to fix random crashes experienced by players in the last months on Unreal Engine games. Please consider updating your drivers to their latest version. 
We hope that the combination of these two elements will significantly reduce the occurrence of random crashes you may experience.[/list]

[h3]Localization fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*]Fixed missing German translations of multiple object’s descriptions.[/list]

[h3]General Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*]Fixed texture loading & streaming issues when running the game at low resolutions or low texture quality settings.
[*]Game progress is now saved immediately when exiting to the main menu while playing in Collectible Mode.
[*]Improved the reliability of depth of field effect’s while focusing on some characters, objects and some specific scene setups.
[*]Fixed Lip-sync missing on multiple ‘onomatopoeia’ along the game.
[*][spoiler]In Chapter ‘Lights, camera, action!’, fixed Kat's visual disappearing after she fakes being electrocuted on the deer enclosure's.[/spoiler]
[*]In Chapter ‘Remember Us’, fixed Nora's car being invisible when she drives out of the parking lot.[/list]

[h3]Performance Improvements[/h3]

[list]
[*]More memory optimizations, allowing faster streaming and removing occurrences of ‘out of memory’ crashes on consoles.
[*]Improved FPS in multiple scenes, in particular for outdoor and in vicinity of the abyss.[/list]

notes.title: Lost Records: Bloom & Rage – Tape 2 (PS5) Review
notes.content:
At long last, we return for the grand finale of Lost Records: Bloom & Rage. If you’ll recall from my previous review, I was a little underwhelmed by the game’s first Tape, and I had hoped the second would pull it out of a tailspin and present something worthwhile. Unfortunately, as I played through the entirety of the second act, hoping for some delivery on the game’s bigger ideas, I was once again left wanting.

Since I have already covered the first Tape fairly comprehensively, this review will be a little different from my usual style. The majority of the game remains largely the same, so I’m not going to go into laborious detail about gameplay or audio-visual design. Instead, I want to focus on the most crucial element of this game that doesn’t work: the overall narrative design.

I touched on it in my first review, but I want to elaborate on the structure of this game’s narrative because for me, it doesn’t really work—not only as a story split into two... Read more

notes.title: HotFix 2.2 (build 1.02.120542)
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

This patch introduces key improvements to save-game stability, story progression, and overall game behavior.

We’ve resolved multiple bugs causing save-game issues, fixed progression blockers, and addressed multiple game crashes. If one or more camcorder footage files are lost: we strongly recommend not to play in Collectible mode at this stage.

Please note that while this update helps prevent new save-game problems, it cannot restore previously lost saves. Players affected by this issue will need to start a new Tape 1 save to continue into Tape 2. We understand this is far from ideal and deeply apologize for the inconvenience.

Before patch 1.02.120542, save-game issues could manifest in 2 ways:

 
[b]1/ The main save-game file is lost[/b]

[list]
[*] It became too big at one point, failed to perform its next save, and is no more present in the save storage of your machine.
[*] This would manifest by having the save-game not showing anymore in save slot selection menu.
[*] This issue had more chance to occur when ending the story while having recorded a lot with the camcorder, or when trying to complete all the collectibles.
[*] The associated camcorder footage files are still in the save storage of your machine.
[/list]

[u]How can you know your save-game is lost?[/u]

[list]
[*] The save-game disappeared from the game’s save slot selection menu.
[/list]

[u]If you save-game is lost, what should you do?[/u]

1. You have to install the patch 1.02.120542 before doing the next step.
2. You must clear the game’s save storage on your machine and restart a new game (only reinstalling the game is not sufficient).

1. First, disable Steam Cloud Sync.
[list]
[*] Open Steam and navigate to your Library.
[*] Right-click on the game and select “Properties.”
[*] Go to the “General” tab and uncheck the box labeled “Keep games saves in the Steam Cloud”.
[/list]

2. Then locate and delete your local save-game files.
[list]
[*] Open your File Explorer.
[*] Delete any file or folder in C:\Users\[YourUserName]\AppData\Local\Bloom&Rage\Saved\
[/list]

3. Upload the new clean save-game to Steam Cloud.
[list]
[*] While the Steam Cloud Sync is still disabled, launch the game to create a new local save.
[*] Start a new story, wait for the first dialogue to play, then return to main menu.
[*] Exit the game.
[*] In the game’s Properties, re-enable Steam Cloud Sync.
[*] Launch the game.
[*] A message will show up mentioning there is a conflict between your local and cloud saves. Make sure to choose to continue with the local save. This will erase your cloud save and replace it with the new save.
[/list]

[b]2/ One or more camcorder footage files are lost:[/b]

[list]
[*] The main save-game got a trace of a recorded footage, but the footage itself is no more present in the save storage of your machine.
[*] The issue can occur in multiple ways, just playing story mode, or after manipulating footage in the memoir menu (deleting junk footage, reorganize clips in a memoir, etc.).
[/list]

[u]How can you know your save-game is containing broken footage?[/u]

[list]
[*] You notice a blank or broken thumbnail for some footage in the camcorder memoir menu.
[*] You are unable to replay a footage in the camcorder memoir menu.
[*] You cannot progress the story in Movie Night chapter, in the garage.
[/list]

[u]If your save-game contains broken footage, what should you do?[/u]

[list]
[*] DO NOT delete your save-game.
[*] The dev team is still working on ways to fix the save-game. This will be released in a later hotfix.
[*] In the meantime, update to latest patch 1.02.120542, as it contains plenty of fixes to avoid creation of broken footage.
[*] Again, we strongly recommend not to play in Collectible mode until the next patch release. We know there are still bugs in the Collectible mode, such as deleting a footage causing broken footage in Story mode.
[/list]

Please do not hesitate to report any bug you encounter in-game to our [url=https://support.dont-nod.com/hc/en-gb/requests/new]support platform[/url].

Thanks for your understanding.

notes.title: Lost Records: Bloom & Rage – Tape 1 (PlayStation 5) Review

I had been keeping my eye on Lost Records: Bloom & Rage ever since I saw the first trailer drop during the 2022 Game Awards. DON’T NOD has been pretty consistent with their games ever since the first Life Is Strange, and even though these kinds of episodic narrative games have fallen somewhat out of fashion as of late, you can always count on them to bring something weird and wonderful to the table.

notes.title: Everything You Need to Know About Lost Records: Bloom & Rage – FAQ
notes.content:
[h1][b]Everything You Need to Know About Lost Records: Bloom & Rage – FAQ  [/b][/h1]

Hi there! We’ve compiled answers to your most pressing questions about Lost Records: Bloom & Rage! 

[h2][u][b]General Information [/b][/u][/h2]

[b]What is Lost Records: Bloom & Rage? [/b]
Lost Records: Bloom & Rage is a single-player narrative adventure game set over two timelines, following four high school girls who form lasting friendships over the summer, only to face a mysterious event that will change them forever. The game explores themes of identity, rebellion, and friendship. 

[b]When will Lost Records: Bloom & Rage be released?  [/b]
Unravel the mysteries of Velvet Cove right now in Tape 1, “Bloom”, and April 15 in Tape 2, “Rage”. “Rage” will become available as a free downloadable update when it is released.  

[b]What platforms is the game available on? [/b]
The game will be available on PC (Steam), PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. 

[b]Will the game be available on PS4 or Xbox One? [/b]
No, the game is not backward compatible with PS4 or other older consoles. 

[b]Is the game multiplayer? [/b]
No, the game is a single-player experience focused on narrative exploration. 

[b]How long is the game? [/b]
The game offers approximately 10-12 hours of playtime, depending on your playstyle and exploration. 

[b]Can I save my progress anywhere? [/b]
The game uses automatic saves and checkpoints regularly – there are no manual saves. 

[b]Does the game have a photo mode? [/b]
Yes! 

[h2][u][b]Themes and Story Content [/b][/u][/h2]

[b]Does the game address sensitive themes? [/b]
Yes, Lost Records: Bloom & Rage explores deep and emotional themes. While the narrative is crafted with care and sensitivity, some scenes may evoke strong emotions. We recommend checking out the dedicated page here if you’re concerned: https://dont-nod.com/en/lost-records-bloom-rage-content-warning-en/ 

[b]Is there replayability or multiple endings? [/b]
Yes! Your choices in both the past and present will change the outcome of both timelines.

[h2][u][b]Technical Specifications [/b][/u][/h2]

[b]What are the recommended PC specs to play Lost Records: Bloom & Rage? [/b]

Please note that an SSD is required to run the game for all specifications. 

[u]Minimum Specifications [/u]
[b]OPERATING SYSTEM:[/b] Windows 10 
[b]PROCESSOR:[/b] Intel Core i7-2700K or AMD FX-8350 
[b]MEMORY: [/b]8GB RAM 
[b]GRAPHICS: [/b][b]GPU supporting DirectX 12 with Shader Model 6.6 is mandatory[/b], NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti, 4GB or AMD Radeon RX 560, 4GB or Intel ARC A380, 6GB 
[b]DETAILS:[/b] Low 720p @ 30 FPS 

[u]Recommended Specifications [/u]
[b]OPERATING SYSTEM: [/b]Windows 10 
[b]PROCESSOR: [/b]Intel Core i5-11400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X 
[b]MEMORY:[/b] 16GB RAM 
[b]GRAPHICS: [/b]NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080, 10 GB or AMD RX 6800XT, 16GB 
[b]DETAILS:[/b] High 1080p @ 60 FPS 

[u]Very High Specifications [/u]
[b]OPERATING SYSTEM: [/b]Windows 10 
[b]PROCESSOR: [/b]Intel Core i5-12600K or AMD Ryzen 5 7600X 
[b]MEMORY: [/b]16GB RAM 
[b]GRAPHICS: [/b]NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, 24GB 
[b]DETAILS:[/b] Very High 2160p @ 60 FPS 

[b]Do I need a controller to play? [/b]
No, the game supports both controllers and keyboard/mouse setups. 

[b]Does the game have accessibility features? [/b]
Yes, Lost Records: Bloom & Rage includes a variety of accessibility options and customizable controls on PC and console. Settings include motion sickness options, gyro assisted controls for the camcorder, icons for off-screen speakers, readable text, toggleable crosshairs for first and third person.  

[b]Does the game require an Internet connection?[/b] 
No, the game can be played offline. The choices summary screen will then lack the World and Friends statistics but the rest of the experience will remain the same. 

[b]Does the game support ultrawide monitors or other PC-specific features? [/b]
The game will come with DLSS/FSR support but no ultrawide support. It’ll run without issue on ultrawide monitors, but there will be black bars on the sides to avoid visual issues. 

[b]Does the game require AVX?[/b] 
On PC, the game requires that the CPU supports the AVX feature but AVX2 is not required. 

[h1][u][b]Release Information & Pre-Orders[/b][/u][/h1]

[b]What is the game’s price? [/b]
Lost Records: Bloom & Rage is a premium game with a one-time purchase. It will be priced at €39.99/$39.99/£35.89, with a launch discount of 10% until March 4. This price includes both parts of the game—“Bloom” (Tape 1) and “Rage” (Tape 2).  

Tape 1: Bloom will launch on February 18, 2025, while Tape 2: Rage will be released as a free downloadable update on April 15, 2025. 

[b]Can I buy the tapes/episodes separately? [/b]
No, the tapes will not be sold separately. When you purchase the game, you’ll gain access to Tape 1: Bloom at launch and Tape 2: Rage when it becomes available on April 15, 2025. 

If you buy the game before April 15, 2025, you’ll be able to enjoy Tape 1 immediately upon its release and automatically unlock Tape 2 when it launches. 

[b]Will there be a physical edition of the game? [/b]
In partnership with Maximum Entertainment, a physical PlayStation 5 edition will be available in Summer 2025. Pre-order now from participating retailers [url=https://dont-nod.com/en/lost-records-bloom-rage-physical-edition-retailers/]HERE[/url].

notes.title: Don't Nod is delaying its spiritual successor to Life is Strange and being refreshingly honest about the reason
notes.content:
Don't Nod, the studio that created the Life is Strange franchise in partnership with Square Enix, has announced that it will be delaying its upcoming self-published title Lost Records: Bloom & Rage into 2025. Lost Records was initially announced at The Game Awards last year, with the release window at the time given as "late 2024".

If you're the gossipy type, it's probably not hard to speculate on why this might have happened, since Square and LiS's adopted step-developer Deck Nine recently announced a new game in the series. While a new Life is Strange was always understood to be a likelihood, few expected the fifth main game to return quite so strongly to the series' roots, with original protagonist Max Caulfield returning as the player character in Life is Strange: Double Exposure, due to release this October.

What's pleasantly surprising, though, is that Don't Nod hasn't taken the circumspect route with regards to their reasons for postponing Lost Records, with CEO Oskar Guilbert saying quite plainly: "We know that many of our fans are eagerly awaiting this game, just as they are the recently announced next instalment of Life is Strange. Let's give both games the space they need to shine. The wait will be worth it."
